mapper.sql: SELECT P.CAMPAIGN_NO , P.CAMPAIGN_TITLE , P.CAMPAIGN_CONTENT , P.START_DATE , P.END_DATE , P.ENROLL_DATE , P.VIEW_COUNT , P.STATUS , P.MEMBER_NO , C.CATEGORY_NO , C.CATEGORY_NAME , A.FILE_NO , A.REF_BNO , A.ORIGIN_NAME , A.CHANGE_NAME , A.FILE_PATH , A.FILE_LEVEL , A.UPLOAD_DATE FROM CL_CAMPAIGN P JOIN CL_CAMPAIGN_CATEGORY C ON P.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO LEFT JOIN CL_CAMPAIGN_ATTACHMENT A ON P.CAMPAIGN_NO = A.REF_BNO
mapper.select: WHERE A.FILE_LEVEL = 0 AND P.STATUS = 'Y' AND (P.END_DATE IS NULL OR P.END_DATE >= SYSDATE) ORDER BY P.CAMPAIGN_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
WHERE A.FILE_LEVEL = 1 AND P.STATUS = 'Y' AND (P.END_DATE IS NULL OR P.END_DATE >= SYSDATE) AND P.CAMPAIGN_NO = #{campaignNo} ORDER BY A.FILE_LEVEL ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_CAMPAIGN P JOIN CL_CAMPAIGN_CATEGORY C ON P.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO LEFT JOIN CL_CAMPAIGN_ATTACHMENT A ON P.CAMPAIGN_NO = A.REF_BNO WHERE A.FILE_LEVEL = 0 AND P.STATUS = 'Y' AND (P.END_DATE IS NULL OR P.END_DATE >= SYSDATE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_LIKE WHERE CAMPAIGN_NO = #{campaignNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CL_CAMPAIGN_LIKE ( LIKE_NO , CAMPAIGN_NO , MEMBER_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_CL_CAMPAIGN_LIKE.NEXTVAL , #{campaignNo}, #{memberNo} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_LIKE WHERE CAMPAIGN_NO = #{campaignNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_CAMPAIGN SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE CAMPAIGN_NO = #{campaignNo}
mapper.select: SELECT R.REPLY_NO AS replyNo , R.REPLY_CONTENT AS replyContent , TO_CHAR(R.ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS enrollDate , R.CAMPAIGN_NO AS campaignNo , R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , M.NICKNAME AS writer FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_REPLY R JOIN CL_MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.CAMPAIGN_NO = #{campaignNo} AND R.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY R.REPLY_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CL_CAMPAIGN_REPLY ( REPLY_NO , REPLY_CONTENT , ENROLL_DATE , STATUS , CAMPAIGN_NO , MEMBER_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_CAMPAIGN_REPLY_NO.NEXTVAL , #{replyContent} , SYSDATE , 'Y' , #{campaignNo} , #{memberNo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_CAMPAIGN_REPLY SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE REPLY_NO = #{replyNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_REPLY WHERE CAMPAIGN_NO = #{campaignNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'
SELECT MEMBER_NO FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_REPLY WHERE REPLY_NO = #{replyNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'
